A university newspaper (1 September 2022): the mother of a 32-year-old transgender man from a neighbouring country, who co-founded a trans-rights group abroad and studied at a major foreign university, alleges he was beaten by police and received inadequate medical care before dying in a large-city hospital while still in police custody, days after being arrested for marijuana possession at this country's airport on his honeymoon; the family alleges extortion demands rising from 100,000 to 200,000 dollars, claims the arrest was motivated by racism and transphobia, and says they hold evidence of torture, disputing the official account.

A regional-affairs magazine feature (14 August 2026) on this country's trans community facing growing repression: the president's October 2025 presidential decree listed "the promotion of LGBTQ+ culture" among nonmilitary security threats alongside terrorism and drugs; a wave of vigilante mob attacks on trans women during 14-16 July 2026, including in a major city, followed, as the government moves to codify anti-LGBTQ+ attitudes into law.
